scaled_synthetic_cqa.description: Runnable scaled CQA benchmark used by the train/test gym split; no paper table value exists for this generated dataset.

mrr.description: Mean reciprocal rank over all synthetic CQA queries.

hits1.description: Fraction of queries whose first-ranked entity is a correct answer.

hits10.description: Fraction of queries with a correct answer in the top ten ranked entities.

mrr_1p.description: Mean reciprocal rank on single-hop path queries.

mrr_2p.description: Mean reciprocal rank on two-hop path queries.

mrr_3p.description: Mean reciprocal rank on three-hop path queries.

mrr_2i.description: Mean reciprocal rank on two-way intersection queries.

mrr_2in.description: Mean reciprocal rank on intersection queries with negation.

trace_variable_mrr.description: Mean reciprocal rank for intermediate variable rankings on path queries.

trace_variable_p1.description: Precision at one for intermediate variable choices on path queries.

trace_path_p1.description: Fraction of path queries whose top trace forms a valid reasoning path.

param_count_k.description: Trainable parameter count in thousands, used as a model-size constraint.

paper_standard_fb15k237.description: Paper Table IV/V main-result aggregate on FB15k-237 for Skolemization-based CQA methods. Metrics are percentages reported in the paper.

mrr_A.description: Published aggregate MRR over all FB15k-237 query families.

mrr_Ap.description: Published MRR over positive FB15k-237 query families.

mrr_An.description: Published MRR over negated FB15k-237 query families.

hits1_A.description: Published Hits@1 over all FB15k-237 query families.

hits1_An.description: Published Hits@1 over negated FB15k-237 query families.

paper_negation_ablation_fb15k237.description: Paper Table VII negation-ablation results on FB15k-237. Metrics are MRR percentages for negated query families.

An.description: Published aggregate MRR over negated FB15k-237 query families.

2in.description: Published MRR on two-way intersection queries with negation.

3in.description: Published MRR on three-way intersection queries with negation.

inp.description: Published MRR on intersection-then-path negated query families.

pin.description: Published MRR on path-then-intersection negated query families.

pni.description: Published MRR on path-negation-intersection query families.
